title: Wispr raises $280M at $2B valuation as it looks beyond dictation | TechCrunch
summary: Wispr , a startup known for its AI dictation tool, raised $280 million in Series B funding, led by Menlo Ventures, at a $2 billion valuation, the company announced on Monday.
